title: the-present-tense-corpus-rewrites-once
intention: Sweep the present-tense corpus once: rewrite every standing dated-append shape out of the artifacts readers load by default — the probe's present-tense set (every intention+why.json in cairn class-space, CLAUDE.md, MAP.md; measured 120 candidate shapes across 56 artifacts) — so each reads as written today with provenance shrunk to ticket-id pointers. Per site the sweep JUDGES: a shape narrating a change is rewritten whole; a shape citing a source (a ruling date, a quote date) is legitimate pointer provenance and stands. Every judgment lands as a training pair in cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/probes/dated_append_judgments.json — the data sibling a-dated-append-in-a-charter-is-a-red will build the canonical checker from.
why: The parent rule is ruled and signed; the corpus still carries the house style it killed. A dated paragraph in a default-loaded artifact reads as current to a model reader (Akien's lived observation, 2026-08-15), so every standing specimen is live noise — and each new charter is written by copying a sibling's, so the specimens are also templates. The sweep is the migration corollary executed: atomic in one voyage, this ticket's cursor the sole owner of the partway. Its close settles ruling 2026-08-15-an-artifact-is-present-tense-or-past-tense-never-both-rescoped's one UNTOUCHED (ground_loop's charter is a specimen) and arms the parent probe's trigger.
traces_to: Parent ticket an-artifact-is-present-tense-or-past-tense-never-both (named child; the migration corollary's one-time sweep). Law 9 (an older translation is not evidence about the source), Law 1 (a stale claim read as current makes the resolver re-litigate the settled).

proves_green.prove_gate: code-seam's proof gate — the tester runs proofs/ beside cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler and emits a VALIDATION; verdict and seal from the same hand.
proves_green.proof_gate: two teeth a hollow build cannot pass: (i) NON-VACUITY — the scanner detects a planted narrating-shape in a fixture, so zero-on-live cannot be a broken scanner going green; (ii) LIVE INVARIANT — survey_the_corpus() returns zero matches over the present-tense set (a no-op sweep reds against the 120 standing specimens; a later red is a real regression, which is the parent probe's finding, not a stale snapshot).
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: Done when: (a) survey_the_corpus() returns zero matches over the present-tense set — the same instrument that measured the debt; (b) the non-vacuity tooth still detects a planted specimen; (c) the ruling settles (ground_loop's charter no longer byte-identical to intake — a consequence of the rewrite, not a separate act); (d) this ticket at PROVED arms the parent probe's trigger. Wrong-intent tells: a rewrite loses design information git cannot recover; most matches judge as legitimate citations, meaning the v0 list rather than the corpus was the defect and the work belongs to the pattern-list sibling.
falsifier.horizon: one voyage, atomic per the parent's migration corollary; a partway state with no cursor owning it is the forbidden shape. Scope is the probe's instrumented set verbatim — code comments and state files, though present-tense by the parent's intention, are the pattern-list sibling's scan-extension question, not silent scope here.
